spec.footprint: 18 ft diameter stem, 30 ft diameter cap, plus a 7 ft bath pod growing off the back
spec.pad: fits 35 x 50 pad with 2.5 ft to spare each side
spec.materials: Stem: shotcrete or SIP panels with lime plaster; cap: sprayed foam roof over steel ribs, elastomeric coating in red with cream spots; gill soffit: tongue-and-groove cypress; porthole windows 3 ft round; oak plank deck
spec.concept: A single tall-stemmed amanita with the sleeping loft inside the cap, a round skylight at the crown, and a baby mushroom as the bathroom pod. The cap overhangs 6 ft all round so the stem stays in shade.
spec.florida: Round shell sheds hurricane wind well; foam roof needs Miami-Dade rated coating; raise finished floor 18 in on a slab plinth; mechanical closet under the stair.

spec.footprint: 14 x 24 ft main body, 9 ft octagonal turret, 6 ft deep front porch
spec.pad: fits 35 x 50 pad; total length with porch and steps 36 ft
spec.materials: Board-and-batten in charcoal slate with black-plum trim; steep 24:12 standing-seam roof in matte black; turret with fish-scale shingles and a witch-hat spire; turned porch posts; tall 2 x 6 ft lancet windows with amber glass; wrought-iron weathervane; brick chimney
spec.concept: A narrow Gothic cottage with a steep gable, a corner turret with a reading nook, a hooded front porch on a raised lattice base, and a sleeping loft tucked under the roof with a round attic window over the door.
spec.florida: Steep roof and turret need engineered wind bracing (Zone 2, 140 mph); raised floor gives flood clearance and crawl-space ventilation; amber glazing must be impact rated; shutters double as storm protection.

spec.footprint: 12 x 26 ft core on 7 ft stilts, 6 ft screened porch wrapping the front and both sides (24 x 32 ft overall), 11-tread front stair
spec.pad: fits 35 x 50 pad; overall length with stair 43 ft
spec.materials: Pressure-treated pier grid with cross bracing; cypress board-and-batten walls; 5V-crimp galvanized tin hip roof with 2.5 ft overhangs and a vented cupola; fibreglass screen panels between 6 x 6 posts; louvered shutters in bottle green; rain barrel; oak porch floor
spec.concept: A Florida cracker house lifted clear of the wet ground on piers, wrapped in a deep screened porch for bugs and afternoon rain, with a cupola pulling hot air out through the roof and shutters that close for storms.
spec.florida: Stilts put the floor above the flood elevation and let storm surge or lake rise pass under; hip roof and short overhangs perform best in hurricanes; screens and cross-ventilation reduce cooling load; cupola needs a storm closure.

spec.footprint: 24 ft diameter saucer on three legs, 6 ft ground clearance, 14 ft boarding ramp at the front
spec.pad: fits 35 x 50 pad; saucer plus legs 26 ft wide, with ramp 34 ft long
spec.materials: Steel ring frame with SIP wedge panels; aluminium composite skin in brushed silver; dark rim band with eight 2 ft acrylic portholes; 8 ft acrylic dome skylight over the bridge; three welded steel legs on 2.6 ft foot pads with tie-downs; aluminium boarding ramp; LED ring under the hull
spec.concept: A classic saucer hovering 6 ft off the ground on three legs. The bridge sits under the dome at the centre where the ceiling is 9 ft; the ceiling falls to 4.5 ft at the rim, so the outer ring holds bunks, seating and storage. A ramp drops from a hatch at the front.
spec.florida: Round aero shape sheds hurricane wind; 6 ft clearance beats flood elevation; legs need engineered footings and tie-downs; dome needs a storm cover; skin colour keeps it cool.
